create-booklet-pdf__v2.title: Create Booklet PDF from Existing Document
create-booklet-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet layout from an existing PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor and save the result as a new PDF.

create-2x2-nup-pdf.title: Create 2×2 N‑up PDF Layout
create-2x2-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a 2‑by‑2 N‑up layout (2 rows, 2 columns) using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp.

create-3x3-nup-pdf-layout.title: Create 3x3 N-up PDF Layout
create-3x3-nup-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to combine nine pages into a single page arranged in three rows and three columns with the MakeNUp method.

create-4x4-nup-pdf-layout.title: Create 4x4 N-up PDF Layout
create-4x4-nup-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a PDF with a 4‑by‑4 N‑up layout (four rows and four columns) from an existing document.

create-booklet-layout.title: Create Booklet Layout for Double‑Sided Printing
create-booklet-layout.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to generate a booklet layout suitable for double‑sided printing with a single API call.

create-2x3-nup-pdf-layout.title: Create 2x3 N-up PDF Layout
create-2x3-nup-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF where each page contains two rows and three columns of the original pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp method.

create-5x5-nup-pdf-layout.title: Create 5x5 N-up PDF Layout
create-5x5-nup-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates how to generate a 5‑by‑5 N‑up PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to place 25 original pages on each output page.

create-booklet-pdf-default.title: Create Booklet PDF with Default Settings
create-booklet-pdf-default.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to convert an existing PDF into a booklet using the default settings.

create-a5-booklet-pdf.title: Create A5 Booklet PDF
create-a5-booklet-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF with A5 page size from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

create-booklet-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.title: Create Booklet PDF Using PdfFileEditor
create-booklet-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, specify left‑ and right‑hand page arrays, and generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet method.

create-custom-booklet-pdf-a5.title: Create Custom Booklet PDF with A5 Page Size
create-custom-booklet-pdf-a5.description: Shows how to load a PDF, define custom left/right page ordering, and use PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet to generate a booklet with A5 pages.

create-booklet-pdf-using-pdffileeditor-s.title: Create Booklet PDF Using PdfFileEditor Streams
create-booklet-pdf-using-pdffileeditor-s.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to convert an existing PDF into a booklet layout by reading and writing through FileStream objects.

create-booklet-pdf-a5-stream.title: Create Booklet PDF with A5 Page Size Using Streams
create-booklet-pdf-a5-stream.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF via FileStream, using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a booklet with A5 page size, and saving the result to a new file.

create-booklet-pdf-left-right-pages.title: Create Booklet PDF Using Left/Right Page Arrays
create-booklet-pdf-left-right-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a booklet PDF by providing custom left‑hand and right‑hand page order through FileStream objects.

create-a5-booklet-pdf__v2.title: Create A5 Booklet PDF Using PdfFileEditor
create-a5-booklet-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to open a PDF via FileStream and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet to generate an A5 booklet saved as a new PDF file.

create-2x2-nup-pdf__v2.title: Create 2×2 N‑up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-2x2-nup-pdf__v2.description: Loads a PDF, applies a 2×2 N‑up layout with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and saves the combined document.

create-3x2-nup-pdf.title: Create 3x2 N‑up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-3x2-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply a 3 rows × 2 columns N‑up layout using A4 page size with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and save the resulting document.

create-2x3-nup-pdf.title: Create 2×3 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-2x3-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, generate a 2×3 N‑up layout using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and save the resulting document.

create-2x4-nup-pdf.title: Create 2x4 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-2x4-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a 2‑by‑4 N‑up layout from an existing PDF and save the result.

create-4x4-nup-pdf.title: Create 4x4 N‑up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-4x4-nup-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, arranges its pages in a 4×4 N‑up layout with PdfFileEditor, and saves the result as a new PDF.

create-5x1-nup-pdf.title: Create 5×1 N-up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-5x1-nup-pdf.description: Loads a PDF file, applies a 5‑by‑1 N‑up layout with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and saves the combined document.

create-1x5-nup-pdf.title: Create 1×5 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-1x5-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a 1‑by‑5 N‑up layout PDF from a source file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp.

create-3x3-nup-pdf.title: Create 3×3 N-up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-3x3-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a 3×3 N‑up layout saved as a new PDF file.

create-4x2-nup-pdf.title: Create 4×2 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-4x2-nup-pdf.description: Loads a source PDF, generates a 4‑row by 2‑column N‑up layout using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and saves the combined document.

create-6x2-nup-pdf.title: Create 6×2 N‑up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-6x2-nup-pdf.description: Loads a source PDF, arranges its pages in a 6‑by‑2 N‑up layout using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and saves the combined document.

create-2x6-nup-pdf.title: Create 2×6 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-2x6-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp to produce a 2×6 N‑up layout saved as a new PDF file.

create-7x1-nup-pdf.title: Create 7×1 N-up PDF with PdfFileEditor
create-7x1-nup-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a 7‑by‑1 N‑up layout from a single PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and save the result.

create-1x7-nup-pdf.title: Create 1×7 N-up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-1x7-nup-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying a 1‑by‑7 N‑up layout with PdfFileEditor, and saving the resulting document.

create-6x6-nup-pdf.title: Create 6×6 N-up PDF using PdfFileEditor
create-6x6-nup-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a 6‑by‑6 N‑up layout from a single PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

create-5x5-nup-pdf-layout__v2.title: Create 5x5 N-up PDF Layout
create-5x5-nup-pdf-layout__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to generate a 5×5 N‑up layout from a single PDF and save it as a new document.
